caption: KEDA extends Kubernetes' HPA with external metrics — exactly what queue-depth scaling needs.
code:
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
spec:
  minReplicaCount: 2
  maxReplicaCount: 12
  triggers:
    - type: prometheus
      metadata:
        query: avg(inference_queue_depth)
        threshold: "5"
